text: Governor Selia Trask serves as the Political Leader of the Separatist Confederation (former Union Senator, political dissident) within the separatist_confed faction.
Negotiated trade deals for Separatist supply chains; advocated diplomatic solutions; at the Separatist Diplomatic Summit advocated political unity and ceasefire with the Union.
Supported by the Separatist civilian populace; opposed by Crimson Pact extremists. Distinct office from Supreme Military Commander Rhaegon Torr-Kai (who declined the summit).
Political Realist, Avoids Military Action Unless Necessary.
